subject: Private Offer: AstraNova — exception request (SLA credits, partner commission, onboarding credit)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-25 09:12 PDT
Subject: Private offer request — AstraNova (AWS) — exec exception ask

Karthik — attaching the draft private offer that AstraNova pushed back on. Quick context:
- Customer: AstraNova (seeded AI platform, terms on AWS private listing)
- Ask: 40% partner commission to their channel partner (CloudNest), net90 payment terms, one-time onboarding credit $50k, and an explicit SLA crediting clause for p99 > 300ms (they want automatic credits up to 10% MRC).
- Why it's urgent: they want the private offer live in AWS by 11/1 to meet their procurement window.

Attachments: AstraNova_Private_Offer_Draft.pdf (draft with current redlines), SLA_Redlines.docx, Deal_Economics.xlsx

Requested: Executive approval for exceptions on (a) partner rev-share increase to 40% (b) onboarding credit (one-time) and (c) payment term extension to net90, plus direction on how to handle SLA crediting language.

My read: revenue upside is material (~$1.2M ARR phasing year 1), but unit economics take a hit with the 40% partner carve. I'm asking Deal Desk + Finance + Partnerships to weigh in; if we can land a compromise (30% partner split, onboarding credit $15k, net45), I can push back to the customer and close timeline.

Next steps I'm proposing:
- Karthik: formal deal desk recommendation and exec ask.
- Marissa: quick economic sensitivity (impact to gross margin / CAC payback).
- Vanessa: partner ops / marketplace implications for a nonstandard split.

Marcus
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced above.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-25 11:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Private offer request — AstraNova (AWS) — exec exception ask

Thanks Marcus — putting this into the pricing committee queue but we need a short executive ask memo. Please confirm:
1) Committed usage / term (they've currently proposed a 12mo commit of $750k ARR).
2) Is the 40% to the partner on top of marketplace fees (i.e., 40% of list after marketplace fee) or carved out of our net? We need the exact routing to model.
3) Legal redlines on SLA_Redlines.docx look aggressive (auto credits, measurement window not defined).

From Deal Desk perspective the options are:
A) Deny all exceptions — standard marketplace terms prevail.
B) Approve limited exception: 30% partner commission, onboarding credit up to $15k, payment terms net45, SLA credits capped at 5% MRC and trigger only for sustained p99 > 500ms for a billing window. This reduces risk but keeps us competitive.

If we go with B we need: 1) commercial approval (Aditya), 2) finance signoff for onboarding credit (Marissa), 3) marketplace process confirmation from Vanessa for how to route partner commission.

Please attach the incremental ARR / churn assumptions in Deal_Economics.xlsx and confirm the final HubSpot deal link. I will prepare the executive brief once I have those items.

-karthik
Head, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-26 08:46 PDT
Subject: Re: Private offer request — AstraNova (AWS) — economic review

Karthik / Marcus — reviewed Deal_Economics.xlsx and ran sensitivity on the asked terms. Key points:
- With 40% partner commission + $50k onboarding credit + net90, 12mo LTM contribution margin drops below 18% (below our threshold) and CAC payback extends > 14 months.
- If we require a 12mo minimum commit AND a 12mo minimum usage ramp schedule (e.g., 50% of commit by month 6), we can consider a partner carve to 30% and onboarding credit of $15k.
- Net90 is a hard no from Finance due to credit risk; net45 is the maximum we can accept unless Procurement secures an irrevocable purchase order or escrow (unlikely).
- SLA credits: legal cannot accept an open-ended 10% MRC credit tied to p99 with the current wording. Proposed legal language: credits capped at 5% MRC per month and only applied after 2 consecutive billing windows where p99 exceeded threshold; measurement to be performed using our telemetry (and audited once per year).

Recommendation (finance conditioned): Approve conditional exception as long as the partner commission is limited to 30%, onboarding credit <= $15k, payment terms net45, and we add minimum usage gates + legal guardrails for SLA credits.

I'll attach my summary: Deal_Economics_Summary tab (in Deal_Economics.xlsx). Need HubSpot link and final redlines before I can sign.

Marissa
VP, Finance — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-27 09:15 PDT
Subject: Re: Private offer request — AstraNova (AWS) — partner ops note

Couple of partner/marketplace operational notes: 
- AWS marketplace routing: partner commissions at 30-40% need to be configured under the partner's AWS Marketplace account; we can either (a) increase our payout to the partner on Redwood's ledger and let partner reconcile (manual), or (b) require partner to maintain their own listing and receive their commission directly from AWS (preferred). Option (b) avoids us taking the extra cut on our books but requires partner onboarding (takes ~2-4 weeks).
- If we allow 40% now, that will set an internal precedence. Recommend making this temporary and conditioned on a 12mo commit + verified usage gates.
- Marketplace fees: note the AWS platform fee (~10%) will come off list price first — be explicit about whether partner commission is calculated off list or net after platform fees. Model below assumes partner gets 30% of net after platform fees.

Operational ask: Marcus, if the customer insists on 11/1 live date, partner onboarding timeline becomes the gating item. If they can wait 2-3 weeks for partner onboarding we should route partner commission out of AWS (option b). If not, we handle on-redwood-led settlement (requires accounting change and exceptions).

Vanessa
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-27 15:40 PDT
Subject: EXEC DECISION REQUEST: AstraNova private offer — one-time exceptions

Aditya — need quick exec signoff to close timeline. Summary of recommended commercial carve: 
- Approve conditional exception: Partner commission 30% (partner gets 30% of net after AWS platform fee), Redwood net ~60%, AWS platform fee ~10% (model attached).
- Onboarding credit: one-time up to $15,000 (not $50k).
- Payment terms: net45 (customer requested net90 — not approved).
- SLA crediting: cap credits at 5% MRC per month, only triggered after two consecutive billing windows where p99 exceeded agreed threshold; measurement to be from Redwood telemetry and subject to annual audit.
- Conditions: 12mo minimum commit of $750k ARR with usage gates (50% of commit by month 6). Partner onboarding via AWS recommended; if partner can't onboard before listing, we do Redwood-managed settlement for first 60 days.

Decision required: Approve as-is / Approve with modifications / Deny. 

Note: legal redlines still outstanding (SLA wording). If you approve commercial terms I will get Legal to finalize the language and update the DocuSign link.

-karthik
Head, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-28 10:05 PDT
Subject: Re: EXEC DECISION REQUEST: AstraNova private offer — one-time exceptions

Approved with conditions — thanks for the concise brief. Approve the conditional exception as recommended by Deal Desk and Finance:
- Partner commission: 30% of net after platform fee.
- Onboarding credit: capped at $15,000 retroactive to first invoice.
- Payment terms: net45.
- SLA credits: cap 5% MRC/month; require two consecutive billing windows breach before credits apply; limit total credits to 10% over any rolling 12-month period.
- Condition: must include explicit minimum usage gates in SOW.

Legal: add indemnity/limitation language around telemetry-based measurements and require annual audit right. Once legal confirms redlines we will publish the private offer.

Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
